task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens the Weasis medical viewer and loads the brain MRI study from the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the Weasis application open with brain MRI slices visible in the viewport and the study path or patient ID matching the target directory.

task_completion.description: The agent performs linear measurements for the Evans Index (maximum width of frontal horns and internal diameter of the skull).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual measurement lines (calipers) on an axial slice of the brain showing the width of the frontal horns and the maximum inner skull diameter.

task_completion.description: The agent measures the width of the third ventricle and the temporal horns as required by the morphometric assessment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement annotations/calipers specifically targeting the third ventricle (central) and the temporal horns (lateral/inferior) on appropriate MRI slices.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the annotated measurement image to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or a 'Save/Export' dialog showing the file being saved as 'evans_index_measurement.png' in /home/ga/DICOM/exports/.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a structured text report containing all measurements and a clinical determination regarding NPH.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view showing the content of 'nph_assessment_report.txt' with numerical values for Evans index, third ventricle, and temporal horns, plus a conclusion.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform measurements rather than simulating results via terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis measurement tools (ruler/caliper icons) and active drawing of lines on the MRI slices.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report should correspond to the visual annotations made in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values visible in the Weasis 'measurements' overlay/sidebar must match the values written in the final .txt report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing report from the source directory to the export directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually typing the report or using a text editor to format the findings based on the observed measurements.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Evans Index is calculated as the ratio of the maximum width of the frontal horns to the maximum internal diameter of the skull; a value > 0.3 is the standard threshold for ventriculomegaly in NPH. The required measurements for a complete assessment are: frontal horn width, biparietal (inner skull) diameter, third ventricle width, and temporal horn width. The target files must be saved exactly to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/evans_index_measurement.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/nph_assessment_report.txt.
